title: Star documents and keep them at the top of the library
objective: Let a person star the documents they care about. PUT /api/documents/:id/star with { starred: true | false } stars or unstars (one control, same click). Stars are per person (store.db.stars). Starred documents sit at the top of that person's library under a Starred heading (an element with data-testid="starred-heading"), in the order they were starred, and the rest follow as today. Each row has a star control (data-testid="star", aria-pressed="true" when starred). GET /api/documents returns starred: true|false for the person, and libraryPage(store, userId, { starred: true }) or ?starred=1 shows only starred documents.
acceptance: Starring puts the document at the top under a Starred heading, in the order starred
Unstarring with the same control returns it to its place
Stars are per person: a teammate's library is unchanged
The API returns starred for the person, and the Starred filter shows only starred documents
Each row has a star control showing its state
plan_summary: A stars table in data, star/unstar in store.mjs, a PUT route, ordering in listDocuments for the page.
